brief: Draft a concise operator note describing the cleanroom first-boot gate suite: what lba-gate-suite.service runs after lbabus builds, that it self-certifies the binary offline (version + agents/docs embed round-trip + drift detection), that it writes /opt/lba/gate-suite-receipt.json as durable evidence, and that setting LBA_GATE_BEACON_HOSTS beacons the verdict over the lbabus bus.
